items.headline: Stock Market Today: Dow, S&P 500 Futures Rise, Nasdaq 100 Futures Fall as Trump Signals Iran War to End ‘Fairly Soon’ — CRWV, TTWO, BW In Focus
items.summary: U.S. futures were mixed as Dow and S&P rose, Nasdaq fell. Trump cited Iran peace progress; markets see 82.2% odds of a December Fed hike.

items.headline: 'This Is Not The Moment To Get Bearish': Morgan Stanley's Mike Wilson Sees Market Correction Nearing End, Stays Selective on Chip Stocks
items.summary: Last week’s crash wiped $3 trillion off the S&P 500, but Morgan Stanley’s Mike Wilson says the correction looks much closer to its end.

items.headline: 'Did He Mislead His Board?': Former SEC Chair Questions Jensen Huang's Nvidia Disclosures, Warns NVDA Will Face ‘Some Tough Choices’
items.summary: Gensler questions whether Jensen Huang misled investors over alleged ties to a suspected Chinese spy as probes and a lawsuit pressure company.

items.headline: Jim Cramer Calls AMD a Winner After 13% Surge, But Warns US Data Center Roadmap Is 'Suspect'
items.summary: Jim Cramer called AMD a winner as shares jumped more than 13%, but warned that a multi-year data center roadmap in the U.S. is now suspect.

items.headline: Dow Surges 1,100 Points As Oil Prices Fall: Investor Sentiment Improves, Greed Index Moves To ‘Fear’ Zone
items.summary: U.S. stocks rallied Monday as oil prices fell; Dow jumped 1,104 points, S&P 500 and Nasdaq gained 2.35% and 2.74%, while sentiment improved to Fear at 32.

items.headline: Jensen Huang Affair Could Have a Bigger Impact on America's AI Race Than Nvidia, Says Gene Munster: 'Both Democrats and Republicans Will Need to...'
items.summary: Munster said the Huang controversy highlights the need for the U.S. to accelerate AI data center construction.

items.headline: 'Objectively Hilarious': Anthony Pompliano Sees Jensen Huang Affair Potentially Marking the Bottom for AI Stocks — What Do Crypto Bettors Think?
items.summary: Anthony Pompliano, CEO of ProCap Financial Inc. suggested on Monday, November 9, that the controversy surrounding NVIDIA Corp. CEO Jensen Huang could mark a turning point for battered AI stocks.

items.headline: BlackRock Canada Announces Special Distribution for iShares Canadian Real Return Bond Index ETF
items.summary: BlackRock Asset Management Canada Limited announced a special cash distribution for the iShares Canadian Real Return Bond Index ETF (XRB) following the maturity of underlying real return bonds.

items.headline: Securities Class Action Lawsuit Filed Against NVIDIA Corporation
items.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against NVIDIA Corporation, with law firms soliciting investors who suffered losses during the specified class period.

items.headline: Trump Sees 'Positive Momentum' to End Iran War After Qatar PM Meeting, But Tehran Tells Washington to 'Surrender'
items.summary: Trump hinted at an imminent end to the Iran war, but Tehran rejected claims of diplomatic progress as oil prices fell on renewed peace hopes.

items.headline: 'Materially False and Misleading': Nvidia, Jensen Huang Sued Over Alleged Chinese Spy Affair, Shareholder Says NVDA Stock Was 'Artificially Inflated'
items.summary: Nvidia and CEO Jensen Huang were sued over alleged false statements, after Huang admitted a relationship.

items.headline: Anthropic’s S-1 Hides Its Most Bullish Number, Says Larridin CEO
items.summary: Larridin CEO Russ Fradin says Anthropic’s most bullish S-1 number shows Fortune 500 customers have barely begun spending on AI.

items.headline: CVS Health Collaborates With Ronald McDonald House to Support Families
items.summary: CVS Health continues its partnership with Ronald McDonald House Global, hosting Halloween-themed events and providing seasonal decor and care packages for families.

items.headline: Microsoft and Northern Trust Expand AI Collaboration
items.summary: Microsoft and Northern Trust have announced an expanded collaboration to deploy an AI-powered client onboarding agent for Northern Trust's asset servicing platform.

items.headline: Nvidia Is Now Nearly 3 Times Cheaper Than Intel on Forward Earnings
items.summary: Nvidia’s forward P/E has fallen to 11.8 versus Intel’s 33.3 as AI enthusiasm cools and a scandal involving CEO Jensen Huang weighs on the stock.

items.headline: Why Is SunCar Technology Stock Jumping Today? (UPDATED)
items.summary: SunCar Stock Surge follows a 26% revenue growth forecast, return to profit and a $10 million share repurchase program.

items.headline: Kevin O'Leary Calls Texas Political Shift a 'Shockeroo' for AI Investors, Says 'That Capacity Will Go Somewhere Else'
items.summary: O'Leary warns Texas' political shift could disrupt AI investments, but says surging demand for computing power will push companies elsewhere.

items.headline: Eco (Atlantic) Oil & Gas Concludes Namibian Licenses Farm-down to BP Unit
items.summary: Eco (Atlantic) Oil & Gas has finalized the farm-down of its Namibian offshore licenses to a subsidiary of BP.

items.headline: Bernstein Analysts Comment on Marks & Spencer's Midterm Guidance
items.summary: Analysts at Bernstein noted that the new midterm guidance issued by Marks & Spencer ahead of its capital markets day exceeded their expectations, signaling a more confident phase for the company.

items.headline: BT Group Postpones Starlink Partnership Amid Ukraine Interference Concerns
items.summary: BT Group has decided to delay its planned partnership with Starlink, citing concerns over signal interference related to the situation in Ukraine.

items.headline: Charming Medical Limited Announces Nasdaq Delisting Determination and Suspension of Trading
items.summary: Charming Medical Limited announced that trading of its securities on the Nasdaq Stock Market was suspended on November 9, 2026, following a delisting determination.

items.headline: ASE Technology Unit Signs NT$590 Million Construction and Engineering Contract
items.summary: A subsidiary of ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd. has entered into a construction and engineering services agreement valued at NT$590 million.

items.headline: EU Regulators Seek Feedback on Deutsche Börse's Allfunds Takeover
items.summary: European Union antitrust regulators have initiated a process to gather feedback from market participants regarding the proposed acquisition of Allfunds Group plc by Deutsche Börse.

items.headline: Silicon Labs and Tuya Smart Announce Integration of SiWx917 SoC into TuyaOpen

items.headline: 3i Infrastructure PLC Scheduled for Quarterly Results
items.summary: 3i Infrastructure PLC is listed among companies scheduled to report quarterly results on November 10, 2026.

items.summary: DCC Energy plc reported a 20.2% increase in first-half revenue to £7.29 billion and announced the sale of its Nexora business for $725 million.

items.headline: Standard Chartered Expands Digital Assets Prime Brokerage Partnership with 24X
items.summary: Standard Chartered has expanded its partnership with 24X Bermuda Limited to include digital assets prime brokerage, enabling institutional trading in Bitcoin and Ethereum.

items.headline: Bodycote plc - Holding(s) in Company
items.summary: Bodycote plc has released a standard TR-1 notification regarding major holdings in the company.

items.summary: DYXnet, a wholly owned subsidiary of VNET Group, partnered with the social welfare organization Lok Sin Tong to donate 500 meal boxes to underprivileged individuals.

items.headline: MBSB Bank Partners with Wise Platform for Global Easy Transfer Service
items.summary: MBSB Bank Berhad has expanded its partnership with Wise Platform to launch the 'Global Easy Transfer' (GET) service, enabling customers to perform international money transfers of up to RM150,000 per

items.headline: Vodafone Raises Full-Year Guidance Amid Strong Business Performance
items.summary: Vodafone Group raised its full-year guidance for adjusted EBITDA after leases to between 13.2 billion and 13.4 billion euros, citing cost savings and strong business-focused operations.

items.headline: Lloyds Bank Plc Issues Floating Rate Covered Bonds Due 2032

items.summary: CRH Americas Materials has acquired the assets of Western Rock Resources and Columbia Northwest Recycling to expand its aggregates footprint in the Pacific Northwest.

items.summary: Apple has received regulatory approval for its AI features on tablets and laptops in China, with local market adaptations developed in partnership with Alibaba.

items.headline: CATL and SERES Group Sign Long-Term Strategic Cooperation Agreement
items.summary: CATL and SERES Group have entered into a long-term strategic partnership to deepen collaboration on battery supply, production capacity, and global market expansion.
